verdict.rationale: Perplexity's core interaction is natural language: typed or spoken questions with follow-up threads ([perplexity-docs-11], [perplexity-docs-39]). Its Assistant takes natural-language commands to draft emails, schedule appointments and book reservations ([perplexity-docs-9]). Computer accepts delegated multi-step tasks and launches a browser automatically ([perplexity-docs-5], [perplexity-docs-30]). One user report says it has replaced Google for them ([perplexity-comm-12]), but another says Computer often fails to trigger from the UI and sessions stall ([perplexity-comm-7]), so the agentic side of the story is shaky. Missing for 10: reliable hands-on evidence that agentic natural-language actions (Computer, Assistant) complete as claimed, and in-depth first-party docs on Assistant command scope.
